training.guide: 6x64 coarse/coarse versus coarse/fine versus learned zero
training.loss: Unchanged full-timestep noise MSE plus coarse source-guide consistency for t<=300
training.final_weights: Raw common final epoch, no validation checkpoint selection
training.sampling: Historical patient/cell balancing, independent seed/data/noise/drop streams
training.precision: FP16 autocast plus bounded identical-draw scaler backoff; persistent failure fatal

evaluation.outside_range_policy: Retain and report separately as flagged offline research; excluded from operating-point selection.
evaluation.selection_rule: Require direction coverage, patient-macro SSIM and mean-judge other-axis stability constraints; maximise mean-judge paired target-minus-null hit difference, then lower timestep, then lower guidance. Nonpositive or infeasible candidates produce no selected setting.
evaluation.anatomy_validation: unknown; SSIM constraints are provisional correspondence screens, not anatomical approval
evaluation.judge_input_frame: Invert each source header-derived canonical transform before grading; assessors remain frozen development instruments.
evaluation.reporting: Each named judge, both axes/directions, support strata, patient intervals, all failures; confirmation seeds are stability checks on the same validation patients, not a fresh test.

mask_policy.region_mask: noise_aware_v1, fixed constants and train-only warning cutoffs
mask_policy.warning_cases: Retain every source, flag and report separately; no favourable-case exclusion
mask_policy.invalid_region: Keep whole-image/judge results, set regional metrics missing; advancement unavailable if a primary region is invalid
mask_policy.masking_ablation: Separate later protocol; not bundled into this guide comparison

analysis.uncertainty: Paired crossed bootstrap of patients and training seeds; generation seeds averaged within each crossed cell; per-training-seed patient intervals also required
analysis.primary_contrast: coarse_fine minus capacity-matched coarse_control, correct guide, manufacturer, all requests retained
analysis.margins: Predeclared research tolerances: .005 normalised null-MAD and five percentage points editing; not clinical equivalence/safety margins
analysis.training_replica_rule: All three replica point differences must favour lower target interior MAD and HF residual; all named-judge editing differences must be >=-.05 in each replica
analysis.safeguards: Retain original direction/support and other-axis stability constraints on selection seed, evaluated per training replica; field-strength remains exploratory/infeasible if support missing
analysis.decision: Advancement means a development research candidate for later independent confirmation, never clinical approval or default promotion
analysis.primary_missingness: Any missing crossed cell, replica, generation seed, judge, source or primary regional metric makes the advancement decision unavailable
